name: io.github.jayzht/memory3l-mcp
title: Auditable memory (memory3l)
description: Audited memory over MCP: an append-only fact ledger plus verifiable invariants I1-I5.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORY3L_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Override the location of the memory3l audit core (development against a source checkout).

environmentVariables.name: MEMORY3L_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to the SQLite fact-ledger file to serve.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORY3L_ALLOW_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to also expose the append_facts tool.
